svg.aria-label: Log-scale scatter of the largest absolute difference between ngspice and NumPy at each of 64 slots, all at or below about 5e-16, near float64 machine epsilon, with no growth along the slots. Below, three wire traces from NumPy overlaid with ngspice values, indistinguishable.

g.text: wires 0, 3, 7 of waveform 0 · NumPy lines, ngspice squares
each slot becomes a stage of controlled current sources into 1 Ω: 2,048 stages, 11,953 lines of netlist, one
the worst disagreement is 5.27e-16, at wire 5, slot 59, one step in the last printed digit.
the error does not grow along the slots, so rounding does not compound through the recurrence.
